title: Async/await in depth
units/0/blurb: Waiting vs. working, Task as a promise of a result, and the big reveal: while I/O is in flight, no thread is needed.
units/1/blurb: Your first async method, what to return, where exceptions go, WhenAll and WhenAny, and cancellation with CancellationToken.
units/2/blurb: What the compiler turns an async method into: the state machine, the awaiter, the fast path and ValueTask, ExecutionContext and AsyncLocal.
units/3/blurb: SynchronizationContext, the classic .Result deadlock, ConfigureAwait(false), async all the way and thread-pool starvation.
units/4/blurb: Fire-and-forget and async void, SemaphoreSlim instead of lock, TaskCompletionSource, IAsyncEnumerable and await using, Channel and Parallel.ForEachAsync.
units/5/blurb: ASP.NET Core, WPF and WinForms, Unity: Awaitable, coroutines, UniTask and cancellation tied to the object.
units/6/blurb: ContinueWith and its traps, TaskScheduler and StartNew vs. Task.Run, child tasks, Parallel and PLINQ for CPU work, timers and who holds them, background threads, Register and linked tokens.
units/7/blurb: The memory model and volatile, Interlocked and the CAS loop, spinning vs kernel objects, Monitor and the Lock type, Lazy<T> and concurrent collections. The course final.
